title: Non-atomic updatePool() enables sandwich attacks and extraction
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `YuzuILP.updatePool()` lacks atomicity when updating the pool state, allowing manipulation of `poolSize` in a way that can be exploited through sandwich attacks.  The function directly sets `poolSize` from the externally provided input without validating against the current state or considering ongoing user operations.  ```solidity function updatePool(uint256 newPoolSize, uint256 newDailyLinearYieldRatePpm) external onlyRole(POOL_MANAGER_ROLE) {     if (newDailyLinearYieldRatePpm > 1e6) {         revert Inva
